alerts.title: Mineral Bottom and White Rim Road are Not Recommended
alerts.description: The Mineral Bottom Road switchbacks and west side of the White Rim Road are slippery and muddy due to recent rains. Travel is not recommended until the roads dry out.

alerts.title: White Rim Road Impassable to Vehicles due to Rockfall
alerts.description: A rockfall East of the Murphy Hogback has temporarily closed a section of White Rim Road to 4-wheeled vehicles. Motorcycles, bicyclists, and hikers are able to complete the entire loop. However, vehicles should plan for out-and-back trips via Shafer Trail Road / Potash Road or Mineral Bottom Road.

alerts.title: Trip-planning tips for 2026
alerts.description: Planning to visit Canyonlands this year? To ensure the best experience, please anticipate potentially long wait times at the entrance station. If overlook or trailhead parking is full, plan to return a little later. Please avoid parking on vegetation and roadways to help preserve this beautiful place for everyone to enjoy.
